description.en: The one prose package: how the Keeper writes. The player's act written into the scene in the Keeper's own words, then the world's reply, never the player's sentence pasted back; whole sentences with one focus per paragraph; people who react to what was said and done, answering a genuine question directly when the situation permits, in natural connected speech and their own register, keeping their position; per-beat craft lines in the capsule's style; the turn floor; NPC voice masks and their generation lane; coarse language and an optional density guide. Turn it off and the base keeps only its interfaces.
description.zh-Hans: 唯一的文笔包：守秘人怎么写。把玩家这回合的行动用守秘人自己的话写进场景（不照抄原话、不违背玩家本意），再写世界的回答；整句、一段一个焦点；在场的人对别人的言行作出反应，情势允许时直接回答真正的提问，用自己的口吻自然连贯地说，立场不因换词而动；按 beat 的文风行进胶囊 style；回合地板；NPC 口吻面具与生成车道；粗话开关与可选的密度指引。关掉它，基底只剩接口。

actor_profile_keys.label: mask
actor_profile_keys.ask: one line, only when the book prints this person's speech: their register and flexible habits of address, wording or sentence endings, without requiring a catchphrase or a marker in every sentence

actor_profile_keys.label: in exchange
actor_profile_keys.ask: up to three exchanges the book prints, each on one line: what someone says to this person, an arrow, what this person says back
